recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中到處是細胞質充滿鮮亮橘紅色顆粒的嗜酸性球及其前驅細胞，很多呈雙葉核，數量明顯超過其他造血細胞；左側可見一顆多葉核的巨核細胞，代表嗜酸性球增多。
features: Hypercellular marrow with markedly increased eosinophils and eosinophilic precursors
Bright orange-red coarsely granular cytoplasm; many bilobed nuclei and round-nucleated myelocytes
Megakaryocyte with lobulated nucleus at left
Scattered erythroid precursors with dense round nuclei and neutrophil lineage cells
Fat spaces at corners; no sheets of blasts or mast cell aggregates in this field
describe_en: Bone marrow section (H&E) shows a hypercellular marrow with a marked increase in eosinophils and their precursors, recognized by bright orange-red coarsely granular cytoplasm and bilobed or round nuclei. Megakaryocytes, erythroid precursors and neutrophilic cells are present in reduced proportion. No sheets of blasts or compact spindled mast cell aggregates are seen in this field. Findings are consistent with marrow eosinophilia; clinical correlation, tryptase level, and cytogenetic/molecular testing are recommended to exclude a clonal eosinophilic neoplasm.

ddx.dx: Myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with eosinophilia and tyrosine kinase fusion
ddx.vs: Morphologically identical in many cases; defined by PDGFRA, PDGFRB, FGFR1, JAK2 or FLT3 rearrangements.
Mastocytosis shows compact aggregates of spindled mast cells with clear cytoplasm, highlighted by tryptase/CD117/CD25.
Hodgkin lymphoma shows eosinophils within a polymorphous infiltrate containing large CD30+/CD15+ Reed-Sternberg cells and fibrosis.
Neutrophilic precursors have pale pink fine granules rather than coarse bright orange-red granules on H&E.
